name: Touhou12.3Vita Hisoutensoku
description: Experimental native PS Vita port research and practice prototype for Touhou 12.3
long_description: Experimental native PS Vita port research and practice prototype for Touhou 12.3
requirements:
- Verify your shader compiler is at ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx (ur0:, not ux0:).
- Create ux0:data/touhou123vita/ and copy the four required files from your lawful game installation directly into it. Do not put them in an extra subfolder or ZIP archive.
